theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_bvt_cube_cont_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Euclid k → ℝ), Continuous f → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |f y| ≤ M) ∧ IntegrableOn f {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}
